page.overview:
Who is Attendant J. Black?

Attendant J. Black is a minor character in .

He was clearly uncomfortable being in this place and wanted to get out as soon as they got Michael. He had to sign to get Michael out so he left with E. W. Hoffman outside of the room to get all that done. He along with Attendant L. Evans discussed Michael's last living family member Jamie Lloyd, which awoke Michael and attacked Black and drove his thumb into his forehead.
